mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in unemployment signals labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and declines, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900.0 thousand units, it signals residential construction contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 900.0, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signals aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), a deceleration in GDP growth signals economic slowdown that triggers profit-taking, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annual growth decelerates from >2.5% to <2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.
